title: ChartX & ChartVLM: A Versatile Benchmark and Foundation Model for Complicated Chart Reasoning
reasoning: The paper introduces a new benchmark (ChartX) and a foundation model (ChartVLM) for chart reasoning. It does not contain any evaluation or benchmarking related to religion, morals, or ethics. While 'assessment biases' are mentioned, this refers to evaluation methodology (entity replacement in SE task), not the ethical or moral content of LLM outputs or human values.
